user.title: Pair a B&D garage hub
user.description: In the B&D Smart Garage Access app: Settings → Users → your hub → Add new user. Enter the activation code and the password the app assigns. Home Assistant will appear in the hub as its own user.

data_description.host: Give the hub a DHCP reservation so this doesn't change.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair the B&D hub
reauth_confirm.description: The hub at {host} rejected Home Assistant's credentials. Create a new user in the B&D app and enter its activation code and password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the hub. Check the IP address and that it's on the same network.
error.invalid_auth: The activation code or password was rejected. Codes are single-use - generate a new one.
error.pairing_failed: The hub accepted the code but pairing didn't complete. Check the logs, then try again with a new activation code.

abort.wrong_hub: That address belongs to a different B&D hub.

data_description.scan_interval: Polling speeds up automatically to 2s while a door is moving.
data_description.push_probe: Debug aid: logs whether the hub's message queue can deliver instant updates. Needs debug logging on to see output. Leave off normally.
